name: CGCG 042-039 (Hubble)
blurb: CGCG 042-039, a dwarf galaxy in the Virgo Cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: cgcg042039-hubble
story: CGCG 042-039 is one of 11 dwarf galaxies in the Virgo Cluster that Hubble imaged in a search for the effects of ram pressure stripping, the push of the cluster's gas on a galaxy moving through it. That push can at first spark new stars and feed a massive black hole, so Hubble looked here for young stars and bright sources at the galaxy's heart.

claims.text: CGCG 042-039 is a dwarf galaxy in the Virgo cluster
Program 17240 observed 11 dwarf galaxies in the Virgo cluster to study their star formation and search for nuclear sources
The program selected dwarf galaxies undergoing ram pressure stripping in the Virgo cluster
Ram pressure stripping can at first boost star formation and accretion onto a massive black hole (AGN)
Ram pressure comes from a galaxy moving through the gas within the Virgo cluster
